doc: Evidence tiers for tools/refstudy.py (grade). Percentages are of views. Rules run in this order: D (no reach data), B (boosted-looking), A (proven organic), A- (saves-strong), B' (solid for a big account), R (account-size reach), else C. Set from the round 3 and round 4/5 intakes (docs/research/reference-round45-2026-10.md); override per run with --tiers <file> or per study with meta.json tier_override {tier, why}.
